title: Reception of the RRCReject by the UE

entities.name: RRCReject
entities.description: RRC message sent by the network to reject an RRC connection request from the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives the RRCReject message from the network.

entities.name: Actions specified in clause 5.3.15
entities.description: The set of procedures that the UE must perform upon receiving an RRCReject message, as defined in clause 5.3.15.

relations.description: The UE performs specific actions upon reception of the RRCReject message.
The UE shall perform the actions specified in clause 5.3.15 as part of handling the RRCReject message.
